posts.zh:
dsh-koboldcpp-hands 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。给在线模型装上本地双手：koboldcpp_run 与 koboldcpp_vision 工具把重复的文本与视觉（OCR、图像分析、对比）劳动交给本地 KoboldCpp（llama.cpp）服务器，并按需拉起与管理服务器生命周期。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cddaf80015d48b3a8a19.html
posts.en:
dsh-koboldcpp-hands is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Hands repetitive text and vision labor (OCR, image analysis, comparison) to a local KoboldCpp (llama.cpp) server through koboldcpp_run and koboldcpp_vision tools, with on-demand server lifecycle management.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-cddaf80015d48b3a8a19.html
